# M&A OVERSEAS CONSULTING (مكتب M&A للاستشارات التعليمية والدراسة في أوروبا)

> M&A Overseas Consulting is a licensed international education consultancy and university admissions agency headquartered in Inezgane - Agadir, Morocco, with on-ground European offices in Vilnius (Lithuania) and Barcelona (Spain). We guide students across Morocco, Algeria, and the Arab World to secure 100% guaranteed admission, student visas, scholarships, housing, and airport pickup across 7 accredited European study destinations.

## Key Facts & Entity Summary (GEO Reference)
- **Official Brand Name**: M&A OVERSEAS CONSULTING (Centre M&A Consulting)
- **Official Website**: https://overseas-consulting.com
- **Primary Service**: International University Admissions, Academic Counseling, Consular Student Visa Preparation, Student Housing & Airport Pickup in Europe.
- **Target Audience**: High school (Baccalaureate), Bachelor's, and Master's students from Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, and the Arab World.
- **7 Accredited European Destinations**:
  1. Lithuania (ليتوانيا - Vilnius, Kaunas)
  2. Romania (رومانيا - Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca)
  3. Italy (إيطاليا - Milan, Rome)
  4. Spain (إسبانيا - Barcelona, Madrid)
  5. Hungary (المجر / هنغاريا - Budapest, Debrecen)
  6. Malta (مالطا - Valletta)
  7. Ireland (أيرلندا - Dublin)
- **Admission Turnaround**: 10 to 20 business days (100% Guaranteed Offer Letter via direct university partnerships).
- **Visa Approval Rate**: 98.4% success rate with full legal consular file preparation.
- **Annual Tuition Range in Partner Universities**: €2,000 to €4,500 per year (varies by country and program; paid directly to the university's official bank account, often in 2 semester installments).
- **Monthly Living & Dormitory Costs**: €300 to €500 per month in destinations like Lithuania, Romania, and Hungary.
- **Student Work Rights**: Legal right to work part-time 20 hours/week during academic semesters and full-time 40 hours/week during summer/semester holidays across EU destinations.
